title: Average Trouble
story: average() claims the average of 1 and 2 is 1.
goal: Diagnose the bug, then fix the code so every check passes.
hints: Which divide operator keeps the decimals?
socratic: What did you expect it to do?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?

parrot.says: Squawk! Averages are whole numbers, I think. Probably.

diagnose.question: Which operator causes the wrong answer?
diagnose.why: // is floor division. A true average needs / which keeps decimals.
